question: Mulayam Singh Yadav posthumously received the Padma Vibhushan in 2023. In which category did he receive the Padma Vibhushan award in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Public affairs.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Padma Vibhushan:-**

 
 
• Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, after Bharat Ratna.
 
• It is awarded for exceptional and distinguished service in any field including art, literature, science and engineering, sports, medicine, social work, public affairs, civil service, trade and industry.
 
• **Mulayam Singh Yadav received the Padma Vibhushan award in 2023 in the category of Public Affairs.**
 
 
 
• **Mulayam Singh Yadav:-**
 
 
• He was a prominent Indian politician who served as the Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh three times and was also the founder of the Samajwadi Party.
